scope_reason: In scope: on hard difficulty a zombie breaking a door (EntityAIBreakDoor) calls World.destroyBlockInWorldPartially, which sends S25 to the player; the client draws the door's crack stages from it (RenderGlobal.destroyBlockPartially). ent-door-s1 built and handled one.
notes: The packet is still constructible by the vanilla server; nothing in the native engine needs it. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was not_needed/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: stale since lane/idxclient 9e69e227 (the zombie's door crack, idx-doorcrack-s1: 150 is 606 px against 1,075 without the crack). play.c keeps at most 16 entries and 16 pending S25s a row, where the HashMap is unbounded (more than 16 doors broken at once is not reached by any recording).
